# Test GKEXPERIMENT variable

# go env shows default empty GKEXPERIMENT
go env
stdout GKEXPERIMENT=

# go env shows valid experiments
env GKEXPERIMENT=fieldtrack,staticlockranking
go env GKEXPERIMENT
stdout '.*fieldtrack.*staticlockranking.*'
go env
stdout 'GKEXPERIMENT=.*fieldtrack.*staticlockranking.*'

# go env rejects unknown experiments
env GKEXPERIMENT=bad
! go env GKEXPERIMENT
stderr 'unknown GKEXPERIMENT bad'
